title: Morse flow categories as exit path categories
summary: We prove that the topological flow category $\mathcal{M}$ arising from a Morse-Smale pair $(f,ξ)$ on a smooth closed manifold $X$ is equivalent, as an $\infty$-category, to Lurie's $\infty$-category $\mathrm{Sing}_A(X)$ of exit paths in $X$ with respect to the stratification by the stable manifolds of $ξ$.
